definitions.explanation: To bring something to an end (transitive).

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{終|お}えた。
⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{終|お}える。
⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{終|お}えて⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}した→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧。
examples.english: I finished preparations and set off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{全|すべ}て→全て：03822_subete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レポート→レポート：01543_repooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}き→書く：00477_kaku⟧{終|お}える⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{帰|かえ}れない→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I can't go home until I finish writing all the reports.

notes:
{終|お}える is transitive (takes an object).

TRANSITIVITY:
- {終|お}える (transitive): to finish (something)
- {終|お}わる (intransitive): to end

PATTERN:
- Verb stem + {終|お}える: to finish doing
  - {読|よ}み{終|お}える: to finish reading
  - {食|た}べ{終|お}える: to finish eating

SIMILAR:
- {済|す}ませる: to finish, get done with
